section.label: Billing
section.description: The closed months per tenant: peak, prices, corrections and CSV export.

intro: On the 1st of every month at 00:00 in the installation's time zone the previous month is closed: per tenant and line the month's peak counts, the highest daily quantity, at the prices of the last sampled day. A closed month never changes; corrections stand next to it as entries of their own.
